thread:
morgan: starting release-2026-03-cohort for routing-service v2.9.0. plan: cohort-lock + soft-vent ramp. main changes: model-route tuning + prefix cache warming.

deploy-bot: /deploy release-2026-03-cohort routing-service v2.9.0 - initiated by morgan

morgan: TL;DR:
- flag ff.route.cohort_lock = shadow during deploy
- post-deploy ramp: cohort-based percentages => cohortA 2% -> 8% -> 25% -> cohortB 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> global 100%
- each step soak 90s, quiet window 3m between cohorts
- safety gates: p95 delta <= +125ms, errors <= +0.35% abs, route-specific 5xx < 0.25%
- if cohort breach -> immediate cohort drain + pin old binary for that cohort's region/pool; full rollback if two cohorts fail or global errors > +0.7% for 90s

eli: I'll watch the cohort heatmap and route-specific p95. creating filters for cohort tags.

ivy: infra: prepping cohort pin scripts. will pin old docker tag on pools used by cohorts for 90 minutes post-promote.

deploy-bot: deploy healthcheck: containers ready, smoke ok.

morgan: enabling cohortA 2%: `flags set ff.route.cohortA 2 --release=release-2026-03-cohort`

eli: cohortA 2% soak: p95 +9ms, no error uptick. cache warmup logs:
```
[2026-03-23T11:02:01Z] prefix-cache: cohortA priming chunk 1/4
[2026-03-23T11:02:12Z] route: cohortA session init ok
```

ivy: bumping cohortA to 8% in 60s unless any holds.

morgan: setting cohortA 8% now. `flags set ff.route.cohortA 8`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.route.cohortA -> 8%

eli: 8% soak mark: p95 +40ms, errors +0.03% abs. holding until quiet window completes.

morgan: moving cohortA to 25% after quiet window. `flags set ff.route.cohortA 25`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.route.cohortA -> 25%

eli: while cohortA at 25% a small spike in tail seen in na-east pool: p95 +160ms and a handful of 500s tied to route id. isolating to cohortA na-east nodes.

rahul: recommend regional cohort drain for na-east cohortA nodes and pin old tag there. if that contains, continue to cohortB.

ivy: executing regional cohort commands:
`flags set ff.route.cohortA --region=na-east 0`
```
ssh infra@na-east "sudo runtimectl pin routing-service v2.8.7 --pool=na-east --ttl=90m"
```

deploy-bot: regional flag update: na-east cohortA -> 0%

eli: after regional drain na-east p95 returned to baseline. cohortA remains at 25% elsewhere. global p95 within gate. good containment.

morgan: logging incident for support: minor triage. note: cohortA na-east drained and pinned for 90m. continue to cohortB next.

morgan: starting cohortB 1% now: `flags set ff.route.cohortB 1`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.route.cohortB -> 1%

eli: cohortB 1% soak clean. promoting cohortB to 10% per plan. `flags set ff.route.cohortB 10`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.route.cohortB -> 10%

rahul: monitoring cohortB metrics. ap-south shows slight p95 drift +85ms but under gate. no action.

morgan: moving cohortB to 50% now: `flags set ff.route.cohortB 50`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.route.cohortB -> 50%

eli: cohesion check: global p95 within +80ms, errors +0.04% abs. two cohorts now live (A 25% except na-east, B 50%). proceeding to final global promote after 3m quiet.

ivy: unpin plan note: cohortA na-east will be unpinned after its 90m TTL. infra will watch memory and OOMs during unwind.

morgan: final step: promote global 100% excluding pinned pools. `flags set ff.route.global 100 --exclude-pools=na-east`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.route.global -> 100% (na-east excluded)

eli: global at 100% (na-east still pinned to v2.8.7). p95 stable, errors nominal.

rahul: filed PD ticket INC-2026-420, severity minor: summary "cohortA na-east tail spike -> regional cohort drain + pin applied; contained". assigned to infra + metrics for follow-up.

morgan: release note draft to paste into GH:
- routing-service v2.9.0 deployed using cohort-lock attenuation sequence (cohortA/cohortB then global)
- safety gates and soak/quiet windows described in runbook
- incident: na-east cohortA drained and pinned for 90m due to tail latency; contained, no customer impact
- follow-ups: add cohort-specific warmup in deploy pipeline and cohort heatmap alert; document cohort-lock playbook

ivy: will run unpin for na-east after TTL: `runtimectl unpin routing-service --pool=na-east` and post in this thread.

morgan: thanks team, excellent containment and use of cohort-lock. marking thread to be closed after unpin confirmation. :white_check_mark:
